decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The details submitted are satisfactory and ensure the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for environmental and public safety in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-P.1.8 (Development Proposals on or Near Contaminated Land) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan (UDP) Adopted December 2003.

Condition : 2 - 1.	The investigation scheme shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details hereby approved and shall be completed in respect of each building before it is occupied.  The findings of the additional investigation scheme shall be submitted to the Council and, if necessary, measures identified to avoid risk to public, buildings and environment to prevent pollution of groundwater and surface water and provisions for monitoring contamination both during and after the site is developed. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the identified measures.
description: Following approval for redevelopment of site for residential development (outline) details submitted pursuant to Condition 11 (contamination scheme) of approved planning permission 00657/B/P15 dated 31/08/2001
